sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:34 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Welfare check on Starbucks and Localito Convenience Store, all clear.
Patrolling up Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible and known.
Welfare check along McDonald's Queen Street, 77 Convenience Store and Mid City, all clear. Standby to ensure our presence is known.

Distress call from Hollywood Cafe Wyndham Street. Reported the same poi who stole on Sunday morning returned again and attempted to steal some pies and drinks but was confronted by the store owner. The verbal altercation escalated so the store owner asked for help from a bystander standing outside. After the poi walked out with a Coke Zero drink, the customer intervened and retrieved the Coke Zero after chasing him down Wyndham Street, and the poi left empty-handed. We advised them to file a police report about the incident. We will be standing by at their store every morning moving forward before commencing our patrols and ensuring them that they are safe.
Arrived at response location Hollywood Cafe, retrieved photos and videos of the poi. (Posted onto Auror.) Standby to show our presence before continuing our patrols.
Continuing our patrols. Patrolling down Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible.
Vulcan Lane has been thoroughly checked, no issues.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Shortland Street, no issues found.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane, floor checks completed on ground level and level 1, no issues found.
Arrived at check-in Commercial Bay, full sweep around the area making sure no issues are present, welfare checks commenced along all stores within the location:
McDonald's — heavy presence from street vagrants, asked to move away from the front and side of the store
Standing by to show our presence and waiting on response calls to arise.
Continuing our patrols due to no concerns or issues identified.
Welfare check along waterfront at Queens Wharf, all clear.
Response call from Jo & Joe, reported two male vagrants having a verbal altercation, yelling and swearing at each other. Requesting assistance in case it escalates into a physical altercation.

Call back from Jo & Joe updating us that they have now gone their separate ways and there is no need to continue making our way there. We will still make our way there through our routes to retrieve the photo of the poi.
Welfare check along OK Gift Shop, all clear.
Welfare check along Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths, all clear.
Patrolling down Customs Street to next check point.
Arrived at check-in Kiwi Bank, store still closed but made welfare checks on other stores within the area, all clear.
Arrived at check-in bottom of Fort Street, commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses within the location, all clear.
Standing by to show our presence and waiting on further response calls.
Continuing our patrols due to no activities visible.

Arrived at check-in Wilson's Carpark, welfare check into all stores within the area, all clear. Jo & Joe — photo of the individual has been retrieved; will keep an eye out for the individual in case further issues arise.
Patrolling up Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible, commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses along the way.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Victoria Street intersection, area has been thoroughly scoped out, no issues found.
Arrived at check-in Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street, all clear.
Arrived at check-in Top of Victoria Street, welfare checks commenced along all stores within the area, all clear. Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls to occur.
Continuing our patrols due to no concerns identified.
Response call from Lumi Cafe, reported a group of vagrants smoking substances to the side of their store and the smoke is coming into their business, requesting assistance to move them along.
Welfare check along Crowne Plaza Hotel making our way down to Atrium on Elliott, food court has been checked also, no issues found.
Arrived at response location; the group of vagrants have already moved along.
Arrived at check-in Elliott Street Apartment, no issues visible.
Arrived at check-in Aotea Square, last check point for Delta Route. Standing by to show our presence before continuing our patrols.
Arrived at check-in Top of Mayoral Drive, area has been thoroughly scoped out for any issues.
Welfare check through Queens Food Court, all clear.
Welfare check along Munster Inn and Nandos, all clear.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, no issues found. Commencing welfare checks on all stores and businesses within Lorne Street.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne and High Street intersection, no issues found, just construction noises being loud. Commencing welfare checks along High Street stores.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall, no issues found.
Arrived at check-in Chancery Square, full sweep of the area making sure no vagrants or concerns present. Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls.
Continuing our patrols and making our way to HQ to recharge the ops phone due to low battery.
Arrived at HQ, standby to recharge the ops phone and waiting on further response calls to occur.

Response call from 275 Queen Street, reported a street vagrant with a white dog. Female streetie is yelling at the dog and they are calling for the wellbeing of the dog. Unsure of what to do but making our way there now to calm the situation down.
Arrived at the response location, unable to find the poi and her white dog. Will be scoping the area out and ensuring everything is under control.

Found the individual with the white dog. Poi is known as Desiree; she was just upset that the dog was acting out. No further issues. Advised her to maybe not yell at it so aggressively as members of the public do raise concerns.
On patrols back to HQ and ensuring our presence is visible along Queen Street.
Arrived at HQ, taking our lunch break and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon shift.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radios.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:35 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Commencing patrols outside of HQ. Standing by at the bottom of Wyndham St, welfare checks on stores between Wellesley St East and Wyndham St, all clear, no issues to report.
Response call from Ippondo regarding a male that is outside of their store smoking, asked for assistance in removing him from the premises.
Arrived at Ippondo Queen St, advised the male that he had to move along; he complied with our orders, no issues to report. Standing by awaiting the male to pack up his stuff.

Whilst at Ippondo received a call from Glassons about a male that they have had past problems with; he has walked past their store and made verbal threats towards them, asked for our presence in case he returns. Last seen walking up Durham St West.
Male from Ippondo has packed up his stuff and is now moving along; heading to Glassons Queen St.
Arrived at Glassons Queen St; the manager has provided us with a photo of the male individual. Standing by in case he returns.
Leaving standby area, no issues to report.

Arrived at Pocket Park, welfare checks on stores along Queen St between Wyndham St and Pocket Park, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for any nearby response calls, as well as making our presence known towards members of the public and stores.

Arrived at Commercial Bay, welfare check McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining security presence, as well as on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Arrived at Lower Albert St, welfare check-in on:
All clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at Albert Mart check-in, all clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at St Patricks Square Cathedral.
St Patricks Square Cathedral sweep complete, no issues to report.
Arrived at Good2Go Convenience check-in, all clear, no issues to report, followed by Shakespeare.

All clear, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining security presence for any nearby response calls, as well as on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Arrived at Mayoral Drive check-in, all clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in, welfare check JFC, all clear, no issues to report.
Aotea Square sweep complete, no issues to report. Ending Alpha Route.
Arrived at Queens Court, welfare check-in, all clear, no issues to report. Heading down Queen St.

Arrived outside of Avachi Chicken, welfare check on stores between Aotea Square and Darby St, all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for any nearby response calls as well as on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Arrived at High St check-in, commencing a full sweep of Freyberg Square, Chancery Square and High St, as well as welfare checks on stores whilst doing so.
Full sweep completed, no issues to report, as well as stores no issues to report.
Arrived at Fort St check-in, commencing full sweep down to Gore St, welfare checks on stores whilst doing so.
Full sweep complete, as well as welfare checks on stores along Fort St, Commerce St and Gore St, all clear, no issues to report. Ending Beta Route, heading back to HQ for floor checks.
Heading to Coffee Club Victoria St West to receive access to their cameras in case of need when trying to locate a POI.
Arrived at Coffee Club, standing by.
Arrived back at HQ, commencing floor checks.
Arrived at Darby St check-in, welfare check:
All clear, no issues to report.

Arrived at the top of Victoria St West, welfare check-in on stores within the area that are still open, none have anything to report. Standing by on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area, as well as maintaining security presence.
Leaving standby area, heading over to Wyndham St.
Arrived at Wyndham St check, welfare check-in Shakespeare and Good2Go Convenience, none have anything to report.
Arrived at the bottom of Wyndham St, welfare check-in:
All clear, no issues to report. Standing by for any nearby response calls as well as on the lookout for any problematic issues or vagrants within the area.
Response call from 77 Convenience Store Mid City about a female vagrant that is rolling around on the ground outside of their store, asked for our assistance.

Arrived at 77 Convenience Store Mid City; shopkeeper pointed out which female vagrant it was and the female individual was sitting up on the public seats. Informed by the manager that the paramedics have been contacted. Standing by with the female vagrant until paramedics arrive.
Paramedics have arrived and are now assisting the female vagrant. Standing by in case of any help needed by paramedics.
Paramedics have taken the female individual into their vehicle. Standing by maintaining presence for any problematic issues.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart about a male that is sitting outside of their store, asked for assistance in moving him along.
Arrived at McDonald's Britomart; male has already departed the premises. Standing by in case he returns.
Heading back to HQ to charge ops phone due to low percentage.
Arrived at HQ, charging ops phone (percentage displayed on office camera).
Standing by HQ awaiting night shift, as well as being vigilant to any response calls that we may receive.
Afternoon shift complete, handover to night shift.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone. (Auror reports have been published.)
